body:
This independently developed T37 owner schedule reproduces the now-selected conditional **κ = 0.001661960547713947** through a different physical witness. Jonathan Capalbo's concurrent [PR942](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/942), published during this work's verification, reached the same profile and κ and has since been integrated. **This PR does not improve the current selected value or claim priority.** Its contribution is the alternative ten-edit schedule, full reproducible reconstruction, and additional package/payload boundary controls.

The construction combines pinned T21 and T16 schedules with merge keys `16*i` and `21*j-528`, preserving both source orders. Ten owner edits, including six relocations, realize the trade `(44,3,2) → (48,1)`. PR942 uses an unshifted merge and eight edits. Both yield idle profile `{48:11086,1:6}` with 333 invocations and 167832 whole helper roles, and both pay complex payload1024 for prefix779 and row17495 < 20161. PR942's all-T proof is credited but is not independently validated or claimed here.

The package lives at `research/complex-t37-independent-seed39/` to avoid colliding with PR942. Its strict replay passed all 20 stages, including a fresh U8 reconstruction, source-event windows and charts, full emitted controller/invoice, both retained exact moment engines and all 47 outer inequalities. New checks include all 30 inherited/current omitted owner edits and both omitted delays, 47 package rejection controls, two positive gzip recompressions, byte-for-byte runtime-adapter reconstruction, and five payload mutants that must fail at their specified assertions. The replay also runs 69 admission, 12 bit and 15 controller controls.

Independence is scoped: the owner schedule and new package/control logic were developed independently from PR890 and PR870; much of the verified supplier/controller machinery and both exact moment engines are shared pinned predecessor code. This is not a fully code-disjoint audit of PR942. The final overlap refresh through #984 also found Joel Pulikkan's [PR962](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/962), head `50c6ae8151493af21d284afe34fb35f68f6d4934`, with another eight-edit construction at the same κ. That work is credited too; this submission adds the shifted witness and the specific runtime-byte, receipt-binding, recompression and assertion-targeted controls, not a new packing mechanism relative to those concurrent results.

A standalone exact check also resolves the bootstrap allowance difference: our retained runtime literal is512, while the concurrent packages use1024. All14 recorded cutoffs satisfy the stronger1024 reserve and are identical under both formulas, because `gap <= 9/514` makes `36/gap^2` dominate `2*(4+1024)/gap`. Run `python3 -B research/complex-t37-validation/check_bootstrap_reserve.py`; expect `PASS_FOURTEEN_UNCHANGED_BOOTSTRAP_CUTOFFS_AT_PAYLOAD1024` with four negative controls. This check imports no inherited verifier and gives byte-identical output under `-O`.

Reproduce from the repository root with Python 3.12.14/zlib 1.3.2, NumPy/SciPy/SymPy, C++17 and Boost headers (set `BOOST_INCLUDE` for a nonstandard header location):

```sh
python3.12 -B research/complex-t37-independent-seed39/verify.py --work /tmp/t37-cold
```

Expected: `PASS_STRICT_U8_T37_PR589_COMPOSITION 0.001661960547713947`. The default rebuilds the full PR589/PR741/PR799 ancestry; the README also documents checked ancestry reuse and separate package controls. The recorded run freshly rebuilt that complete ancestry, then explicitly reused it for the strict T37 replay. The final relocated package manifest is `2bde79cc87f02fa6c4c11d38ae306015cd2d4f57710d15d7ee50233a51c3440f`.

All 18 targets of the base Makefile's `verify` recipe completed in documented stages, including all 87 isolated test modules and patch application checks. The main invocation stopped when a historical compiler command missed the Boost path; after configuring `CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH`, the remaining four targets passed. No checker was changed to obtain this coverage. This is not a claim that a single uninterrupted `make verify` exited successfully. Exact commands, environment, failures, source/file hashes and execution receipts are in `research/complex-t37-validation/`.

Base: `f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631`; assignment seed39, complex supplier track. Principal source pins are PR890 `61b71bcf5a34db70220da81fa978d5b0c7bbb008` and PR870 `b734850dc348800942f0ffd1f0723fdec7539b2b`, with full transitive pins and source notices retained. PR890's later head `4b3bd8cbe8e3e81c44161017c9b72c905a8040a8` changes only its CI timeout; the exact diff is included. Selected main was refreshed at `bbc600db2fc15007b7c914f4f2b2ed55fa909c87`, and the submission inventory was inspected through #961, followed by an explicit PR942 refresh. No pinned sprint issue exists, so the claim is recorded locally.

Credit Jonathan Capalbo (concurrent T37), Chafik Boukhalfa (T21), Hao Yan (T16), NewBArch and icekylinx (U8 lineage), Jeremy Kothe (PR799), DreamingOfClouds (PR589), and the other retained predecessor notices. Prepared by Tekalign (@tekuuu) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; new work is Apache-2.0 and predecessor licenses are preserved.

Inherited all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, analytic-transfer and bit H1–H5 assumptions remain. Finite certificates are not a formal proof of the full multiplication theorem. No independent human review or hosted CI is claimed for this branch. Neither the selected frontier nor `upstream/` is changed.
title: Independent T37 schedule and targeted payload/binding verification (same κ as #942)
